text:
maria: Quick sync — I started onboarding cormorant-7b into the model catalog. Need quick eyes on licensing, perf profile, and embedding shape before we schedule a canary. TL;DR: small LLM (7B-ish), Open-source-ish checkpoint from third party, tokenizer is SentencePiece.
ajay: Thanks — do we have the license text attached? any attribution restrictions? :eyes:
maria: License file says 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial' variant — not ideal for hosted. @legal-bot can you verify whether we can offer this on Hosted or only Dedicated/Private?
legal-bot: License review queued. Flags: non-commercial clause present. Recommendation: block on Hosted, allow Dedicated/Private after legal approval. ETA: ~24h. :robot_face:
tess: From perf side — we need P50/P95 measurements at seq_len 128/512 with batch sizes 1/8/32, and token throughput for embedding and generation. Also ping infra for memory footprint.
sam: I can run perf probes today. Plan: run dockerized harness on staging GPU pool and post numbers here. Will do 128/512 x (1/8/32).
maria: great — thx. Sam, use the manifest below for consistency, pls attach results. Also cc @kevin for infra constraints.

```yaml
model: cormorant-7b
tokenizer: sentencepiece
emb_dim: 1536
quantization: none (start)
shapes: {prompt: 128}
``` 

kevin: Quick infra note — on A100-40GB we see ~26GB for fp16 load, kv-cache scales with seq. If you plan q4f/q8 models we'll need to test memory and latency tradeoffs. For batch=32 on seq=512 expect P99 to spike unless batching config adjusted. Also watch for tokenization CPU cost (SentencePiece single-threaded by default).
ajay: Given the license bot flag, can we still run perf in staging? we just need numbers, not serving publicly.
legal-bot: Perf/testing allowed under research/qa, but cannot publish or expose model in Hosted catalog until license remediated. Keep logs internal.
sam: Running first pass now. Command I used:

```
./perf-runner --model cormorant-7b --seq 128 --batch 8 --mode generation --warmup 50 --iters 200
```

Posting numbers in ~45m.
tess: Also need embedding vector dim confirmation. Manifest says 1536 but upstream doc references 1024 for a variant. If mismatch, embedding service needs a conversion shim or we store as separate model entry.
maria: Good catch. Upstream provided two tokenizer configs. I pulled the larger embedding (1536) but will verify. If variant exists we can publish a 'cormorant-7b-embed1024' mapping — but that adds support overhead.
sam: First perf pass: seq=128 batch=1 P50=42ms P95=168ms tokens/s=210; seq=512 batch=1 P50=170ms P95=890ms. For batch=8 numbers look ~x to 1.8x latency but throughput improves. Uploading raw logs to staging bundle: https://internal.redwood.ai/staging/artifacts/cord-1739005555
kevin: Numbers look sane. Next: try q4f quant and rerun memory/latency. I can reserve a slot on Dedicated pool for quick run tomorrow.
ajay: Regarding rollout: given legal block on Hosted, propose plan: 1) run perf + quant tests (this week), 2) internal Dedicated canary (next week), 3) if legal clears, schedule Hosted opt-in later. Does that work for owners?
maria: That works. Ownership: maria (catalog owner), sam (perf owner), tess (quality/perf gating), kevin (infra/ops), ajay (product+rollout), legal-bot & legal team (legal). I'll open a PR for the catalog entry — pinging reviewers.
maria: PR: https://pr.internal.redwood.ai/12345 — pls review and drop short CRs (docs, manifest, license notice). tag: @kevin @tess @ajay
sam: Reviewing PR now, will leave perf notes inline. Quick ask: can we add a small eval set of 20 prompts for quality baseline? tess or product might have examples.
tess: I have a 20-prompt set for Q&A + summarization. Will upload to the PR as gist.
maria: Action items: 1) legal to confirm license remediation path (legal-bot) 2) sam to finish perf + quant runs and upload logs 3) kevin to test q4f memory on Dedicated slot 4) tess to attach eval prompts and produce perf gating thresholds 5) ajay to draft canary routing policy (Dedicated only until license clears). I'll follow up EOD with a short status.
ajay: I'll draft canary policy and post as a short doc by EOD. :thumbsup:
maria: any objections to Dedicated-only canary? :eyes:
kevin: No objections. We should include auto-fallback to a smaller model if latency exceeds SLO.
sam: No objections. Will add latency SLO checks to perf artifacts.
maria: Thanks all — closing for now, will post updates. :raised_hands:
